latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of afrexai-business-automation: transform your AI agent into a business automation architect.

- Guides users through automation audits to identify high-impact, repetitive business processes.
- Provides structured templates for mapping both processes and workflow architectures.
- Includes a scoring matrix to prioritize which processes to automate based on frequency, time, error impact, complexity, and integration.
- Offers detailed workflow examples for sales, finance, HR, support, and reporting use cases.
- Outlines step-by-step implementation guidelines for connecting workflow steps with available agent tools and integrations.
